parts.name: Leg (Left Temple Arm)
parts.Basic_description: This is the left leg (temple arm) of the eyeglasses, made of acetate, a lightweight and flexible plastic material.
parts.Functional_description: It supports the glasses on the wearer’s ear and helps maintain stability and comfort during use.
parts.Movement_description: It can rotate around the hinge joint to fold inward for storage or open outward for wearing.

parts.name: Leg (Right Temple Arm)
parts.Basic_description: This is the right leg (temple arm) of the eyeglasses, made of acetate, providing flexibility and durability.
parts.Functional_description: It balances the frame on the wearer’s head and ensures a snug fit behind the ear.
parts.Movement_description: It can pivot around the hinge to fold or unfold, allowing compact storage and easy wearing.

parts.name: Base Body (Frame and Lenses)
parts.Basic_description: This is the main body of the eyeglasses, consisting of the frame that holds the lenses and the lenses themselves.
parts.Functional_description: It provides the optical correction or protection function and connects both legs through the bridge.
parts.Movement_description: It remains stationary and rigid, serving as the central structural component of the eyeglasses.
